Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the performance numbers. We have an internal security gating item before we can ship any production data into a third-party inference service. We want to run a 60-90 day Private/VPC POC but need two things to proceed: a) a short-term credit or promotional allocation to cover POC usage, and b) a snapshot of your SOC2 scope (or equivalent) and a summary of network isolation / KMS integration for customer-managed keys.

Can Redwood provide a temporary credit (or trial extension) tied to completion of a short security checklist? Our security team will need to review a SOC2 summary and confirm that the control mappings cover data-in-transit and key management. If that looks good we can sign a minimal SOW/PO and start the POC in our AWS account.

I attached the list of compliance checks our reviewer needs. Happy to hop on a call this week.

Thanks,
Elaine

Quick technical estimate:
- Workload: steady 50 reqs/min * 1k tokens = ~3M tokens/day; with bursts as described expect up to 6M tokens/day for 2–3 hours. Over 60 days that's ~180M tokens baseline, 240M tokens with bursts.
- For a VPC Private POC we should provision a dedicated small pool: 1 GPU node (a40/80 equiv) with autoscale policy and burst buffer. Cost-equivalent promo: recommend 200k–300k USD of usage credit (or 200M tokens equivalent) to avoid throttling and give space for exploration.
- KMS: AWS KMS CMKs are fine for this POC; HSM only if they require FIPS/HSM attestation — note that HSM adds provisioning lead time. We can also do envelope encryption so keys never leave customer account.
- Attachments: SOC2 snapshot we typically share (redacted) + short KMS integration note.

If sales wants a smaller commitment we can do a 90-day, $75k promo but require daily usage caps and an automatic throttle if they exceed the agreed token burn. Recommend 60-day, $200k promo tied to signed minimal SOW and an attestation that SOC2 controls are in scope for the relevant data types.

- Dev

Attachment: FinShield_SOC2_Snapshot.pdf (redacted)
